purpose: Documented rescue missions told through coordination, survivor needs, uncertainty, and after-action learning.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Protect survivors and responders; do not turn narrative questions into field instructions or speculate about blame.
